list.name: Concurrency level
list.expr: count_values("c", max(min_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace"}[1m]) > 0 and stddev_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace"}[1m]) == 0)) unless on (c) count_values("c", max_over_time((max(min_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace"}[1m]) > 0 and stddev_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace"}[1m]) == 0))[5m:15s] offset 1m))
list.textFormat: Concurrency plateau: {{c}} in-flight requests at the frontend (sweep step)

description: KubeCon NA 2026 demo: the recorded panels of spec section 11 for the R (KV-aware routing), D (prefill/decode disaggregation) and O (SGLang HiCache) matrix on one p6-b200. Every Dynamo, SGLang and NIXL query is scoped by $namespace (one DGD per namespace); DCGM and node-exporter panels are scoped by node. The demo-bench tables are the numbers of record; panels are illustrations.

panels.title: Frontend TTFT p50/p95
panels.description: Time to first token at the Dynamo frontend, all requests in $namespace. Illustration only: the demo-bench tables over the aiperf window are the numbers of record.

panels.title: ITL
panels.description: SGLang inter-token latency (sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds), all workers in $namespace. In the PD topologies it is dominated by the decode worker.

panels.title: Engine hit rate per worker
panels.description: Token-weighted prefix-cache hit rate per worker pod: rate(sglang:cached_tokens_total) / rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total), all cache sources. Run-level numbers use increase() over the aiperf window (demo-bench). Query B (per dp_rank) is hidden: enable it once T-OBS-1 confirms the engine exports dp_rank on these counters.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, dp_rank) (rate(sglang:cached_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod, dp_rank) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Router predicted hit
panels.description: Mean KV overlap the router predicted at routing time (histogram dynamo_component_router_kv_hit_rate_sum / _count). Observed only with DYN_ROUTER_MODE=kv: empty in the round-robin arm by design.

panels.title: KV events applied
panels.description: KV cache events applied to the router index (events flowing). Needs kv mode, workers publishing events (--kv-events-config) and --router-kv-overlap-score-credit > 0. B shows any event applied with a status other than ok.

panels.title: Load spread: running/queued requests
panels.description: Engine view of load per worker pod, both router arms: running (solid) and queued (dashed) requests.

panels.title: Load spread: active decode blocks / prefill tokens
panels.description: The router's own per-target load view (frontend gauges labelled worker_type, worker_id and dp_rank). Populated only in kv mode. Prefill tokens on the right axis.

panels.title: NIXL bytes transferred
panels.description: NIXL telemetry per worker pod (operator podMonitors.nixlTelemetry; workers with NIXL_TELEMETRY_ENABLE=y). nixl_bytes_transferred is a histogram: _sum is bytes (left axis), _count is transfers (right axis). NIXL transports only; Mooncake exports nothing here.

panels.title: NIXL failed transfers
panels.description: Cumulative failed NIXL transfers per worker pod. Must stay at 0.

panels.title: NVLink throughput (DCGM)
panels.description: DCGM_FI_PROF_NVLINK_TX_BYTES / RX_BYTES are bytes/s gauges (no rate()), summed per GPU-owning pod on the selected GPU node. With the dcgm-exporter chart default honorLabels=false the workload pod is in exported_pod and pod is the exporter. PROF fields on EKS Auto Mode are (M) in T-OBS-1; query C (hidden) is the DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL counter fallback, in raw DCGM units.

panels.title: O: HiCache tiers (L1 device, L2 host, L3 storage)
Tokens by cache source
panels.description: Prompt tokens served from each cache tier (cache_source device / host / storage_<backend>; the "total" fallback series is excluded), stacked over the tokens the engine had to compute (prompt minus cached).

panels.title: HiCache host occupancy
panels.description: L2 (pinned host RAM) occupancy per worker pod: sglang:hicache_host_used_tokens / sglang:hicache_host_total_tokens.

panels.title: HiCache load-back
panels.description: Tokens loaded back from L2 host DRAM to the GPU per worker pod and host pool (SGLang 0.5.18 label pool).

panels.title: HiCache prefetch
panels.description: L3 traffic per worker pod: tokens prefetched from L3 storage into L2 host memory (solid) and tokens backed up from L2 to L3 storage (dashed), sglang:prefetched_tokens_total and sglang:backuped_tokens_total.

panels.title: Node disk reads (md*)
panels.description: node-exporter read throughput, per device, of the NVMe RAID0 (md*) behind /mnt/.ephemeral on the GPU node or, on nodes without a RAID, of the whole nvme disks (on Nitro the EBS root volume is an nvme device too): evidence that L3 hits came from NVMe rather than the page cache (T-HIC-5). Node metrics carry no namespace, so this panel is filtered by the md_instance variable.

panels.title: Cache tier occupancy (L1/L2/L3)
panels.description: Per worker pod. L1 device KV pool held by the radix cache = (sglang:kv_used_tokens + sglang:kv_evictable_tokens) / sglang:max_total_num_tokens. L2 host pool = sglang:hicache_host_used_tokens / sglang:hicache_host_total_tokens. L3 (right axis) = tokens written from L2 to L3 storage since the worker started (sglang:backuped_tokens_total): an upper bound, as SGLang 0.5.18 exports no L3 occupancy gauge and neither L3 eviction nor the cache reset is subtracted.

title: Dynamo on EKS: R / D / O matrix (KubeCon NA 2026)
